title: JEPA-Tuner: From Predictive Fine-Tuning to Asynchronous Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate sequences of actions from visual observations, proprioceptive states, and language instructions. In embodied interaction, executing these actions influences subsequent observations and robot states, providing a natural predictive signal for policy learning. However, standard action-supervised fine-tuning does not explicitly capture these action-conditioned temporal dependencies in the guidance consumed by the action predictor. We introduce JEPA-Tuner, a predictive fine-tuning framework that regularizes the VLA's native policy guidance through action-conditioned future prediction. During fine-tuning, a predictor in JEPA-Tuner learns to match guidance encoded from a future observation given the current guidance and committed actions. This objective encourages a cross-modal guidance adapter to capture how the scene and robot state evolve under those actions, while jointly training the action ex

translated_title: JEPA-Tuner：从预测性微调到视觉-语言-动作模型的异步执行
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根据视觉观测、本体感觉状态和语言指令生成动作序列。在具身交互中，执行这些动作会影响后续的观测和机器人状态，为策略学习提供了天然的预测信号。然而，标准的动作监督微调并未在动作预测器所消费的引导信息中显式捕捉这些动作条件下的时间依赖关系。我们提出JEPA-Tuner，一个预测性微调框架，通过动作条件下的未来预测来正则化VLA的原生策略引导。在微调过程中，JEPA-Tuner中的预测器学习在给定当前引导信息和已执行动作的条件下，匹配由未来观测编码得到的引导信息。这一目标促使跨模态引导适配器捕捉在这些动作作用下场景和机器人状态如何演化，同时联合训练动作执行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: JEPA-Tuner提出一种预测性微调框架，通过让预测器学习匹配动作执行后的未来观测引导信息，将动作条件下的时序依赖注入VLA模型的策略引导中，从而支持模型的异步执行。
en_tdlr: JEPA-Tuner is a predictive fine-tuning framework that regularizes the VLA's policy guidance via action-conditioned future prediction, enabling the model to capture how the scene and robot state evolve under executed actions and supporting asynchronous execution.
